# Hallmark Yula

> Hallmark Yula is a gated community of 183 independent G+2 luxury villas with private lifts, planned across 22.26 acres at Patighanpur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Key facts
- Location: Patighanpur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Total land: 22.26 acres
- Total villas: 183 (G+2 with private lift and terrace)
- Plot sizes: 267, 300, 325, 450, 500, 597 sq. yds — east and west facing
- Built-up area: 4,052 – 7,855 sft
- Roads: 18 m central boulevard, 12 m internal roads
- Clubhouse: Basement + Ground + 3 floors, 20 amenities

## Pricing (per sft on built-up area)
- OTP: ₹8,999 (east facing), ₹8,499 (west facing)
- EOI: ₹10,999 (east facing), ₹10,499 (west facing)
- Starting from approx. ₹3.44 Cr (267 sq. yds, west facing, OTP). Taxes and charges extra.

## Clubhouse amenities
Parking, Banquet Halls (2), Grocery Store, Reception & Pre-function Hall, Banquet Dining, Café & Juice Bar, Kids’ Pool, Swimming Pool, Yoga Room, Activity Room, Gym, Indoor Games, Badminton, Pilates & Fitness Studio, Gentlemen’s Room, Treatment Room, Salon, Store, Lounge, Guest Rooms.
